tropicana cookies x papaya

Chemical Peel 7g Flower

3.desc:
Allday 

Limesicle 7g Flower

 A sativa-dominant plant providing a euphoric high, ideal for those wanting to fight couch lock. Limesicle offers a light, lime flavor profile, that'll elevate anyone's day off adventure. (Zkittlez X Strawberry Zkillato)

4.desc:
Allday 

Orange Cannoli 3.5g Flower

This cross of Tropicanna Cookies and Don Mega #5 from Solfire Gardens is a high yielder with a powerful nose. The breeder describes her like a stinky gym sock filled with oranges, and that's exactly what she is: a healthy blend of citrus and skunk. (Sativa Leaning)

6.desc:
Allday 

Papayamosa 1g (2pk) prerolls 

Talk about the strongest nose in the garden. Papayamosa's sweet, candy terp gives off a fruity pebbles that will make your mouth water. A good blend of frosty and sweet, she's an excellent pick up for those using their nose to select strains. (Sativa Leaning - LCG X Blueberry Mimosa #12)

7.desc:
Allday 

Pinacolado 2.5g (5pk) prerolls 

A cut from Doja Exclusive, this blend of Banana Kush and Starburst Bubba has both a sweet and pineapple flavor profile, as well as a healthy amount of trichomes to match. This one is a must grab for someone looking to enjoy the time by the pool this summer. (Hybrid) (Gelato #41 X Afternoon Pineapple)

8.desc:
Allday 

Rose Pop - 3.5g Flower

Sticky, sweet and floral, this strain's aroma fills the room as we defoliate. Like a rose, this strain is ideal for a walk on a beautiful day; it's the epitome of "stop and smell the roses". (King Slayer X Gastro Pop) Sativa Leaner
